title: create_new_configuration_entry
description: Test creating a new configuration entry with valid configKey and configValue, expect 200 response with saved configuration data.

title: search_configuration_entries_with_pagination
description: Test searching configuration entries using filters with pagination, expect 200 response with paginated list of configurations.

title: update_existing_configuration_entry
description: Test updating an existing configuration entry by configKey with new configValue and notes, expect 200 response with updated configuration.

title: get_configuration_entry_by_key
description: Test retrieving a configuration entry by configKey, expect 200 response with configuration data if exists, 404 if not found.

title: deactivate_configuration_entry_by_key
description: Test deactivating a configuration entry by configKey, expect 204 no content on success, 404 if key not found.

title: create_new_file_category
description: Test creating a new file category with required fields, expect 200 response with created category data.

title: search_file_categories_with_pagination
description: Test searching file categories with filters and pagination, expect 200 response with paginated category list.

title: update_file_category_by_id
description: Test updating an existing file category by id with new names and optional fields, expect 200 response with updated category.

title: upload_file_with_metadata
description: Test uploading a file with required metadata fields (ownerId, ownerType, moduleCode), expect 200 response with file metadata.

title: issue_access_token_for_file_download
description: Test issuing a short-lived access token for a file by id, expect 200 response with access token for secure download.
